ns2:section.sectionText: Domestic Politics & International Relations The international relations scholarship has been increasingly interested in opening up the black box of domestic politics. In this advanced undergraduate seminar, we will study how domestic politics affect foreign policy choices and international outcomes. We will also study how international actors and events shape domestic politics. While we cover a broad range of substantive issues, our primary goal is to understand the conceptual linkages between domestic and international elements.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
